title: MCP Audit Context & Tool Call
description: AuditContext is reconciled with the §3 Request Context shape in 05-mcp-security-governance.md (nested user{id, organization_id, site_id, roles[]}, plus request_id/requested_tool) as of the office-mcp-server (M10) implementation. Before this change the field was a narrower, undocumented flat shape (user_id/org/site/role) with zero consumers in the codebase (grep across apps/services/packages/tests found none), so this is an in-place extension rather than an additive parallel type — see docs/implementation-spec/open-decisions.md D-049.

roles.description: Roles as resolved by the trusted runtime/authentication layer — never taken from Agent Prompt or tool input.

service_id.description: Identifies the Service this run answers for. When `service_version` equals the literal `0.0.0-poc-unregistered`, this value is NOT a Portal-registered Service id — it is a deterministic UUID5 derived from an opaque caller-supplied string (a Hosted Chat slug, or any caller-chosen string in a local/Preview run) because no real Service Registry entry could be resolved for this run (open-decisions.md D-034 (i), agent_runtime.workflow._derive_service_uuid). Any other `service_version` value means both fields were resolved from a real Portal ServiceVersion row (via portal-api's `GET /api/v1/deployments/by-slug/{slug}`, D-038) and can be looked up as such.

service_version.description: The literal `0.0.0-poc-unregistered` is a sentinel, not a real release version — it marks a run whose `service_id` above is derived from an opaque caller string rather than resolved from a registered ServiceVersion (see `service_id`'s description). Any other value is the real `version` string of the ServiceVersion identified by `service_id`.

requested_tool.description: Tool name this context was minted for; the server must reject a call where this does not match the tool actually being invoked.

confirmed.description: §8.4 사용자 확인 정책. Set by the trusted caller (Agent/Desktop Runtime) after it has obtained the user's confirmation for an ALWAYS/ON_PARAMETER tool — never inferred from tool input.
